summary: China SXT Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $100 million in Class A ordinary shares through Univest Securities. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, or restructuring is involved. Sales are at market price; the latest trade was $1.65. Univest receives 3% commission. Risks include Hong Kong/China regulatory environment. No deal terms apply.
